name: jm-tools
description: Working tools: continuation handoffs for a fresh session, adversarial try-to-break-it checks, and before/after visual evidence for UI changes.

interface.shortDescription: Fresh-session handoffs, adversarial checks, and visual evidence
interface.longDescription: handoff writes a continuation packet so work can resume in a fresh session. try-to-break-it exercises a change adversarially and reports reproducible evidence. visual-evidence takes matching before/after screenshots of UI changes.
defaultPrompt: Write a handoff so I can continue in a fresh session.
